feedback: Written before this candidate races. It is the best raced design (iteration 3, score 159.2: kp 2.5, sensor_size 0.016, base_speed 1.3, kd 0.3, ki 0.05, weights [2,1,0,-1,-2]) with one field changed, controller.line_loss from last_direction to search_right. The change is valid and isolates line-loss handling, which iteration 3 flagged: line_loss_events were 1.25 (oval), 2.0 (s-bend) and 1.0 (slalom), with the 16 mm footprint already at its maximum. Iteration 4 showed that raising kp to 3.0 (score 83.5) overshoots and increases s-bend line loss (1.15 at kp 2.0, 2.0 at kp 2.5, 2.0 at kp 3.0), so the kp lever is exhausted and the line-loss rule is the right next test. Steering_oscillation has stayed low (0.11 to 0.28 across iterations 2 to 4), so the controller is not jittering and does not need extra damping for this test. Next race, depending on the telemetry: (a) if line_loss_events fall on the s-bend and slalom while max_error stays at or below about 0.061 m, keep search_right and test base_speed 1.5 as the only change, since iteration 3 suggests speed is adequate on the oval; (b) if line_loss_events rise above 2 on the s-bend, the losses are on the other side, so test search_left as the only change; (c) if max_error stays at about 0.06 m with line losses unchanged, the binding limit is steering authority rather than line loss, so the next lever is kd toward 0.5 (only if steering_oscillation stays below about 0.3).
requested_changes: If line_loss_events fall below 1.0 on the s-bend and slalom with max_error at or below about 0.061 m: keep controller.line_loss search_right and raise controller.base_speed from 1.3 to 1.5 as the only change, since iteration 3 showed the oval finishes at 1.89 s and speed is adequate there.

If s-bend line_loss_events rise above 2.0 with search_right: revert controller.line_loss to last_direction and test controller.line_loss search_left as the only change, because line-loss side is the open question.

If line_loss_events are unchanged and max_error stays at about 0.06 m (iteration 3 showed 0.0606 to 0.0623 m): change controller.kd from 0.3 toward 0.5 as the only change, provided steering_oscillation stays below about 0.3 (iteration 3 peaked at 0.28).
